During the investigation into a serial killer, police become aware that there is a second serial killer on the loose; the second killer believes he is sacrificing people to save humanity.
In Santa Cruz, Calif., police come a cross a series of ritualistic killings; the investigation leads to a self-proclaimed hero who kills to prevent the apocalypse.
In London, prim and proper Carole Waugh is leading a double life as an escort; through her work, she meets a gambler and a swindler; the con goes on after Carol suddenly goes missing.

Yvonne Baldelli and Marine Corps veteran Brian Brimager fall in love and move to a Caribbean island; when Yvonne emails that she's left Brian for another man, her family discovers that the email comes from the United States, and suspects foul play.
A missing newlywed's body is found at the bottom of a Montana waterfall just eight days after his wedding.
When a young marriage ends in suicide, the victim's family presses police to order an autopsy.
A murderous spouse disposes of a dead body at sea after being confronted about an illicit affair; the body is never recovered.
A murder mystery play becomes a reality for a married couple on a Valentine's Day date at an oceanfront resort.
A couple's vacation plans are thwarted when they find out their flight is canceled; they return home to find their house taken over by intruders.
A couple's bickering ends when a hitman shoots the couple's pickup truck right in broad daylight outside a restaurant, killing one of them.
When ex-con Scott Nelson looked at middle-aged nanny Jennifer Fulford he allegedly saw a target for his rage; Nelson had other plans when he entered the courtroom for his trial.
William Coday fell in love with Colombian immigrant Gloria Gomez; when he lived in Germany, he'd thought he had a similar love; Gloria Gomez's life would come to a similarly brutal end.
